title: Email Accounts
subtitle: Manage native Postfix and Dovecot mailboxes. Use SMTP port 587 with STARTTLS for authenticated sending.

generatedPassword.title: Password for {{email}}
generatedPassword.saveNote: Save it now. It will not be shown again.

enable.notEnabled: Email hosting is not enabled for this domain yet.
enable.info: Enabling it adds MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC DNS records when possible.

forwarders.title: Forwarders and Catch-All
forwarders.description: Forward incoming mail to one or more destination addresses without creating a mailbox. Catch-all forwards mail for undefined addresses on this domain.
forwarders.catchAll: Forward all undefined addresses on this domain

spam.title: Spam Filtering
spam.description: Rspamd scores every incoming message. Greylisting temporarily defers, the header threshold flags mail as spam, and the reject threshold refuses delivery.
spam.notInstalled: Rspamd is not installed on this server; settings are stored but not enforced.
spam.enable: Enable spam filtering for this domain

autoresponder.title: Automatic Reply
autoresponder.description: Send a vacation reply from a mailbox, at most once per interval to the same sender.

filters.title: Message Filters
filters.description: Sort incoming mail into folders, redirect it, or discard it with Sieve rules compiled per mailbox.

sendLimits.title: Send Limits
sendLimits.description: Cap outbound recipients per mailbox. Exceeding a limit suspends the account automatically to contain a compromised login. Use 0 for unlimited.
sendLimits.suspendedNote: Auto-suspended at {{time}}. Reactivate the mailbox above to clear it.

messages.enabled: Email hosting has been enabled for this domain. MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records were added to DNS when possible.
messages.spamApplied: The Rspamd spam policy has been validated and applied.
messages.autoresponderSaved: The autoresponder and its Sieve script have been applied.
messages.filterAdded: The mail filter has been compiled and enabled.
messages.sendLimitsSaved: The send limits have been saved.

confirm.deleteMailbox: Delete the mailbox "{{email}}"? The Maildir will remain on disk, and only the account row will be removed.
